frases.Estimá tu posición como astronauta o en: Estimate your position as an astronaut or in a rover after navigation failure, when lost in dust or before an emergency return. With visibility, skyline matching compares mountain silhouettes in your photos with horizons calculated from HiRISE + MOLA-HRSC terrain. In dust, add readings from other instruments.
frases.Prueba a ciegas con Curiosity. Error med: Blind test with Curiosity. Median error of $1 m across $2 stops. $3 fell within the declared interval. The model’s 95% coverage still needs calibration.
frases.Todas las medidas son opcionales. Cargá: All measurements are optional. Enter your readings and their 1-sigma errors. Typical precisions are proposals to calibrate. Combine independent observations for the same position and reference time.
frases.Solución externa de radio UHF con un orb: External position solution from UHF radio with an orbiter. Typical per-axis error of $1 m, a proposal to calibrate. Enter an already solved position and its error.
frases.Rastreador estelar con reloj y vertical: Star tracker with clock and local vertical. Typical per-axis error of $1 m, a proposal to calibrate. One arcminute corresponds to about 988 m on Mars. A coarse position check.
frases.El horizonte se aproxima como una distri: The skyline is approximated by a local circular distribution. If another place looks similar, review the ambiguity before combining.

frases.Sensores de presión exterior simultáneos: Simultaneous exterior pressure sensors on suit and habitat. Typical differential noise of $1 Pa, a proposal to calibrate. Suit internal pressure cannot measure terrain height.
frases.Contador de pasos o distancia medida. La: Step counter or measured distance. Step length of $1 m and relative error of $2%, proposals to calibrate. Heading comes from the Sun, an IMU or the rover. Mars lacks a global magnetic field suitable for compass navigation.
frases.Sensor solar y reloj UTC. Error angular: Sun sensor and UTC clock. Typical angular error of $1°, a proposal to calibrate. Over 10 km solar geometry adds little information. Terrain shadows require a separate observation and are outside this measurement model.
frases.Radio de tiempo de vuelo a una base o ba: Time-of-flight radio to a base or beacon. Typical error of $1 m, a proposal to calibrate. Distance defines an annulus and requires a radio link and synchronization.
frases.Odómetro de ruedas e IMU desde el último: Wheel odometry and IMU from the last known position. Typical relative error of $1%, a proposal to calibrate. Wheel slip can increase the error.
frases.Visor óptico e IMU o referencia solar. E: Optical sight and IMU or Sun reference. Typical bearing error of $1° and laser range error of $2 m, proposals to calibrate. frases.Propuesta del equipo, a calibrar: 25 m e: Team proposal requiring calibration: 25 m is the 95 % uncertainty measured by blind localization using Curiosity photos.
